summary: Crescent Biopharma is a pre-revenue, single-asset biotech whose supply chain is minimal and outsourced to a CDMO. Its entire near-term valuation rides on ASCO 2026 data for CR-001, making it a binary clinical-risk play with cash-runway and dilution risks.

inputs.whyNeeded: Only clinical asset; basis of current market cap
inputs.fragility: Extreme; any negative data or delay destroys valuation
High; a single supplier failure or quality issue halts trial

chokepoints.why: Only catalyst; no other pipeline assets near data; outcome binary
No revenue; must fund operations through data; any overrun forces dilutive raise

customers.why: Ultimate demand if CR-001 is approved; no pre-revenue customers

geographic: US-based headquarters; CDMO likely US or contract; no material geographic concentration revealed
substitutes: PD-1 inhibitors + VEGF inhibitors given as separate combos (e.g., Keytruda + Avastin)
Other PD-1xVEGF bispecifics in development (e.g., from larger pharma)

bearCase: CR-001 data at ASCO 2026 fails to show superiority over PD-1+VEGF combos, stock collapses to near cash value (~$2-3/share).
Cash burn forces dilutive offering before data, crushing existing shareholders.
CDMO delays or quality issues push data readout past ASCO, raising uncertainty and dilutive risk.
Competing PD-1xVEGF bispecific or combo regimens achieve superior efficacy, rendering CR-001 non-differentiated.

loadBearing.assumption: CR-001 trial data at ASCO 2026 will be positive and differentiated
loadBearing.breaksIf: Data show only modest efficacy or no clear advantage over standard-of-care combos

loadBearing.assumption: Cash runway extends >12 months without dilutive raise
loadBearing.breaksIf: Trial costs overrun, or management decides to raise earlier, causing dilution

loadBearing.assumption: Single CDMO can deliver sufficient clinical supply on schedule
loadBearing.breaksIf: CDMO fails a quality audit, faces raw material shortage, or delays batch release

loadBearing.assumption: PD-1xVEGF bispecific class is not preempted by existing combo therapies
loadBearing.breaksIf: Physicians continue preferring separated PD-1 + VEGF regimens, limiting bispecific adoption

prediction.statement: By ASCO 2026 (late May-early June), CR-001 clinical data will be released; positive data drives stock above $30, negative data below $5.
prediction.resolutionCriterion: Check stock price within 5 trading days after ASCO 2026 abstract release/presentation.

gaps: No detailed financial statements (cash balance, burn rate) to model dilution timeline.
Identity and track record of CDMO not disclosed.
No details on CR-001 trial design, endpoints, or comparator arm.
No information on IP/patent protection for CR-001.
verifyThese: Check Crescent Biopharma Q4 2025 earnings filing for cash runway.
Look up CR-001 trial registration (ClinicalTrials.gov) for design details.
Search for any disclosed CDMO relationship (press releases, contracts).
Monitor competitor PD-1xVEGF bispecific data (e.g., from Summit or others) prior to ASCO.
diminishingReturns: Stopped at CR-001 and CDMO because deeper hops (e.g., CDMO's raw materials) do not change the investment picture: the binary driver is clinical data, not supply-chain disruption. Supply-chain risk is secondary to trial risk.
